Generated with [GLAD 2.0.8](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad/tree/v2.0.8), using its bundled registry specifications:

```sh
python -m glad --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions '' --out-path third_party/glad --reproducible c
```

Loaded through `glfwGetProcAddress`. Normal builds compile the generated files directly.
